svg.desc: Batch 2: Rancher (HSB-RNCH) [6ft, 3-Rail]: 4×6 posts (5.5" wide face), 3× 2×6 cedar horizontal boards (non-recommended height option), 2×4 center vertical trim, HeadLOK structural timber screws, pyramid caps. Authored strictly to canonical 104×78 inch artboard, Shell Law, and procedural flow grain.
